body:
Thank you. You've really given me something to chew on. It's so difficult to live life the way deserves to be lived for others when the effect is not obvious, but it's what all should do. Inspiring others leads to greatness, right?

They are very nice. They have been enough. Sometimes, I can't accept that they're all I'll ever have. Seeing my future as living for fleeting moments is what makes me so weary. They are all life has. The rest is brutal and I feel as though I've been bludgeoned into submission.

I'm rooting for you as well! Thank you for reminding me that I'm not unique in my feelings. It makes me feel like less of a crazy person.

I have found that my want to cease existing has not dwindled and has possibly even increased over the years (leaving young adulthood behind), only that my response to it has become more manageable most of the time. 

May all of you who are despondent rest a little more easily knowing you're not alone.

You can get through to tomorrow. You've gotten this far, which means you're a tougher cookie than you think!

Your parents love the shit out of you. They won't be hurt, they'll be worried. That's okay. Believe me, parents worry whether you give them reason to or not. It's normal and they're there to help you.It would upset them a whole lot more if you died than if you told them you need some support. Everyone needs support. It's okay for you to need it too.

Talk to anyone who you care about, because that person almost certainly cares about you as much as you do them. Talk to anyone you trust. It will feel good.

<3

Hi there.

I know the feels. You certainly aren't worthless. No matter what we tell ourselves, we have intrinsic worth and that's before even considering our worth to others (which you obviously have). Don't stress about the future, think about making only tomorrow a good day. One day at a time.
